model.scope: Square causal prompt prefill only; all decode native BF16

arms.B: Native installed Qwen SDPA; fused runtime verification pending

data.language: English instructions and restricted Python; no bilingual claim
data.template: Pinned Qwen non-thinking; generation prompt; no answer continuation
data.filler: Repeated deterministic irrelevant archive notes, plus punctuation for exact length; never truncate core
data.generator_revision: CODE initial = 11 + 64 * split_index + index to prevent cross-split program duplicates
data.future_manifest_selection: Stable SHA256(base_id) ordering within task, not outcomes; not yet executed

boundary_selection.ties: Separate; do not select or refill

metrics.primary: Task-balanced mean paired change of gold choice NLL at standard L4096
metrics.brier: Sum over four labels without division by four
metrics.relative_norm: sqrt(sum squared difference / sum squared reference), null when reference RMS <= 1e-6
metrics.local_queries: floor(i*(N-1)/31), i=0..31, all valid causal keys, all heads
metrics.native_logits: BF16 model logits before CPU FP64 analysis; logits_to_keep=1
metrics.full_KL: Only if actually computed from full final-token vectors; otherwise NOT_COMPUTED
metrics.R: osc(candidate-B option logits) / B winner gap, undefined at ties, post-hoc only

statistics.unit: Task-stratified paired base-scenario cluster; all lengths/arms preserved
statistics.zero_events: Not zero population risk; exact bound requires explicit independent Bernoulli assumption

planned_timing.primary: Synchronized wall-clock model prompt forward with native one-position LM head
planned_timing.cache: Reset each request; no quantized-input memoization

planned_generation.policy: Greedy control; own cache after each arm prefill; decode BF16
comparisons: Incremental common B prefix, score before next reference token
planned_generation.implemented: CPU parser/alignment and prefix iterator only; GPU generation runner pending
